description: Reviewed CI ratchet deltas for intentional functionality added before the architecture snapshots were refreshed. Every allowance is exact so unrelated growth or routes still fail. The route-manifest additions were folded into config/route-manifest.json on 2026-08-05 and again when the earlier Golden Coast phases reached main, so those lists only contain exact reviewed deltas since that snapshot: the three Phase 7 sales-cash-transfer middleware mounts introduced by the Phase 16 HADI transfer guard, the second DELETE /api/vouchers/:id registration that #1206 mounts ahead of the generic voucher delete so Golden Coast POS cash settlements cascade correctly, the root middleware mount that #1274 adds via registerGoldenCoastSystemAccountPresentation to filter the Golden Coast owner-withdrawal clearing account out of GET account listings, the three stock-item history mounts that #1279 adds so enforcePosInventoryCostBoundary redacts inventory cost for POS users without the inventory.cost.view permission, the two reviewed Group Net Position GET routes added by #1331, the three company-scoped Supplier Tracking Defaults routes added by #1357, and the Phase 4 authoritative proforma-capacity read route. config/source-text-assertion-baseline.json was regenerated once audit-source-text-assertions learned to see relative-URL source reads, so every test previously carried here as a reviewed delta now lives in that baseline, which is the canonical list. The source-text allowance covers assertions that landed on main after that baseline was taken, each on a test the baseline already records, led by the #1193 entry in server/routes/sp/spGoldenCoastPhase11MonthlyCloseRoutes.test.ts pinning the shared-charge Decimal expression. The three #1196 assertions in tests/supplier-partner-net-position-inclusion.test.ts that this file used to carry were removed by #1200, so the ceiling drops with them.

sourceTextAssertionDelta.rationale: Each entry asserts a contract that has no behavioural surface. The mobile-responsive files (phase1-critical-flows, wave2-factory-floor, wave3-erp-operations) assert on Tailwind breakpoint classes and data-testid template literals: jsdom applies no CSS, so which of the mobile and desktop views is visible at a breakpoint is only expressible as source text. realtime-wave2-live-page-policy asserts the ABSENCE of polling and of a second WebSocket in live pages — an absence no request can demonstrate. proforma-capacity-concurrency-wiring asserts that every proforma-linked creation path takes the capacity lock before it writes, and that the lock is taken first; ordering inside a transaction is not observable from outside it. company-deletion-contract asserts that storage.ts composes the dependency-aware deletion service rather than a second implementation, which is a wiring fact, not a result. factory-loading-soft-delete-overload-regression asserts that soft-deleted proformas and orders are excluded from the shared capacity snapshot and that both scan and bulk-import source their counts from it; the exclusion is a SQL predicate, so there is no request that can distinguish it from a count that happens to be equal. maxAdditionalTextAssertions is measured exactly at 154 over the reviewed baseline of 2061, so any further growth still fails.
